answer_1.quote: Our method produces interpretable and explainable feedback, unlike conventional pronunciation assessment systems that yield only numeric scores.
answer_1.outputs: Accuracy score, Fluency score, and textual Reasoning feedback

answer_2.quote: We use the Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) as the main evaluation metric since it has often been used in prior studies and provides better interpretability when comparing performance on different datasets.

answer_4.quote: We manually annotated the TextPA reasoning into four categories: hallucination, correct, constructive, and irrelevant.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators classified each reasoning output into the categories based on correctness and usefulness.
